payload.content: ONLY when the question explicitly asks for *distinct*, *different*, or *unique* values (e.g. 'how many different countries', 'list the distinct languages'), use SELECT DISTINCT or COUNT(DISTINCT col). Do NOT use UNION as a substitute for DISTINCT — UNION combines disjoint sets, DISTINCT deduplicates within one set. For 'how many distinct X', use SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X) FROM ...; not nested UNION + COUNT.

rationale: Spider q_asks_distinct=yes (35% fail) often shows UNION mis-usage. Predicate: question matches r'\b(distinct|unique|different|separate)\b' for SELECT, or r'\bhow many (distinct|unique|different)\b' for count. Tightly gated.
